                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 4: Balance ensures success - Incorrect because it talks about combining both methods for success, not specifically about the drawback of smart work alone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Sentence Improvement", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69456a0fbf7b88096e8e3168", "qs_no": 17, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "From a philosophical viewpoint, what does the author suggest about hard work and smart work?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "One must replace the other"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "They are opposing ideologies"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "They must coexist for success"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Smart work alone is sufficient"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is 'Option 3'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A) The passage emphasizes the need to balance perseverance and strategic thinking for long-term achievement.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The author suggests that neither hard work nor smart work alone is sufficient, but their combination leads to success.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • B) The statement "Modern success demands a balance between effort and insight" indicates the need for both hard work and smart work to coexist.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Therefore, the idea that they must coexist is a central theme of the passage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • C) "One must replace the other" and "They are opposing ideologies" are not supported by the author's perspective, which is more integrative.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The passage does not suggest that one should replace the other or that they are in opposition, but rather that they complement each other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • D) "Smart work alone is sufficient" contradicts the passage's assertion that discipline and diligence are also necessary.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Hence, this option does not align with the author's balanced viewpoint.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3: They must coexist for success.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 1: One must replace the other - Incorrect because the passage promotes balance, not replacement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 2: They are opposing ideologies - Incorrect because the passage suggests integrative, not opposing views.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 4: Smart work alone is sufficient - Incorrect as the passage highlights the importance of both hard work and smart work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Verbal Ability", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69456a0fbf58e42ccbdf41bf", "qs_no": 18, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "What does the phrase “reduce wasted effort” imply in context?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Minimize inefficiency"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Increase workload"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Avoid planning"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Depend on tools"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is 'Option 1'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A) The phrase “reduce wasted effort” implies making work processes more efficient by eliminating unnecessary effort.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It highlights the importance of minimizing inefficiency to ensure more productive outcomes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • B) "Increase workload" contradicts the idea of reducing wasted effort and is, therefore, not the correct implication.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Increasing workload would mean adding more effort rather than optimizing the existing effort.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • C) "Avoid planning" does not relate to the idea of reducing wasted effort, since planning is crucial to minimizing inefficiencies.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Avoiding planning would likely lead to more wasted effort, not less.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • D) "Depend on tools" is not directly related to the phrase "reduce wasted effort" in the context of the passage.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • While tools can help with efficiency, the phrase emphasizes the overall concept of minimizing inefficiencies in work processes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1: Minimize inefficiency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 2: Increase workload - Incorrect because it suggests adding more work rather than optimizing effort.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 3: Avoid planning - Incorrect because planning is key to reducing wasted effort.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Option 4: Depend on tools - Incorrect because it does not directly relate to the meaning of reducing wasted effort.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Verbal Ability", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69456a0f7c56ceeb7a26e107", "qs_no": 19, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Which metaphor reflects repetitive effort without strategy?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Assembly line"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Treadmill"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Algorithm"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Shortcut"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is 'Option 2'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A) The metaphor “treadmill” reflects repetitive effort without strategy because it involves continuous movement without forward progress.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This metaphor aligns with the concept of relentless hard work without strategic direction, which leads to burnout rather than achievement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • B) An "assembly line" metaphor usually represents a systematic, organized approach, which doesn’t directly imply lack of strategy.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • An assembly line involves efficiency and a pre-set plan, which are characteristics of smart work rather than repetitive, unplanned effort.
